notes.title: Update 34 | Remade the Mech
notes.notes: Remade the mech to fix the piloting it bug and added some FX for the screens.

notes.title: Update 33 | Bug fixes and climbing
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed the rifles loading magazine hand bug

Changed the grabbing button for the sniper rifle

Removed the chairs from the Board Level to evade the chair bug

Fixed going through the Moon base 3d model 

Fixed going through the street in the Deathmatch level

Fixed the magazine colliding with something when being loaded

Disabled the Anti Aliasing (for now)

Now chosen graphic option will show in green

Reduced the car lights strength

notes.title: Update 32 | VR PWC & Bugs Fixes
notes.notes:
Now we have a new VR mechanic which is the VR PWC. 
You will find this new mechanic in the Beach level.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43102619/135f0cf686990c450512d382aa0e3068eb81db7e.gif"]



Hopefully its not that buggy 😥


Fixes and enhancements:
Now the default graphics option is Low instead of Medium.

Disabled the "Text" thing over the player head.

Grabbing things from a distance is now easier (hopefully). Now objects slow down before reaching the player hand.

The dungeon key now is shiny this way players can easily find it.

Edited the wrong positioning of the dungeon key.

Sniper rifle can now be grabbed like other weapons.

Edited the chair "Stand Up" button position to be easily viewable. (unfortunately the bug of exiting the chair still exist. 

The beach level now had dynamic sky.

Slowed down the speed of the day in the VR Lords.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 31 | Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
This update fixes bugs and have enhancements to the project:



Added: Damage post processing FX when taking damage

Added: Death post processing FX on death

Bug: Fixed dungeon monster attack range bug

Added: Support for  Oculus Controllers Menu button

Fixed: Shadow of the board games level

Fixed: Exiting the board games chair bug (hopefully)

Added: Invisible boarders to all levels

Improvement: Better performance for Arena, Deathmatch, Dungeon, Indoor Shooting, Open Range, Mech Football, The World Between and VR Lords

Thanks for playing Homaysa and best regards,

Mohammed Marzouq

notes.title: Update 21 | Dungeon, The New Horror/Puzzle Coop Game Mode
notes.notes:
Dear Homaysers,

Homaysa now has a new addition. A VR horror/puzzle cooperative dungeon game mode for those who love to play horror with their friends.

The settings is in a scary dark dungeon filled with things that want to kill you if you know how to exit your prison cell. 

[previewyoutube=Dw3X4_nL5uc;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 20: Fixed Mech piloting bug
notes.notes:
This bug has taken a lot of time of me for the past few months and I am to say that at last I figured it out.

Now you can ride the mech without any problem...hopefully.

notes.title: Update 19: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hallo Homaysaers,

Just an update to fix bugs, nothing to see here.


 Fixed: Reduced the sound of the crowds in the Mech football.
 Fixed: Mech now can't move without closing the cockpit.
 Added: Game menu can now be called in any level using the Escape button on the keyboard.
 Added: Graphics options can are now saved. No need to redo them every time the player start the game.
 Fixed: Gun sways when adding a magazine.
 Fixed: Rotation of the guns is wrong.
 Added: Blood VFX when bullets or melee weapons hit the player.
 Fixed: Spark and Blood particle have wrong rotation.
 Fixed: Carried melee weapons doen't seem to be doing any damage.
 Added: Character body now collide with other objects.
 Removed: Text above the player head.
 Fixed: UI is now disabled when clicking the join game button, thus preventing another click.


That's it. Hope you enjoy the new patch.
